title: Agricultural Chemical Storage Safety Plan
description: Free Agricultural Chemical Storage Safety Plan template for agriculture you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers store construction and location, storage practices, spill and emergency kit.

Store Construction And Location

☐ Locked, dry, ventilated store with a bunded floor to contain spills

☐ Away from houses, animal housing, food, feed and water sources

☐ Non-combustible construction, fire extinguisher and warning signs outside

☐ Shelves of non-absorbent material; heavy containers on lower shelves

Storage Practices

☐ Chemicals stored in original, labelled containers

☐ Incompatible chemicals segregated (e.g. oxidisers from flammables, acids from alkalis)

☐ Inventory kept up to date; SDS available at the entrance

☐ First in, first out; expired products disposed of through approved routes

☐ Fuel and fertiliser not stored with pesticides

Disposal

never reuse them for food, feed or water.
